source_delta: Opt-in dual-primary reservation strategy; component physical faces, coordinates, rotations and source footprint documents unchanged
mechanism: Append opposite primary-relative representations, retaining every existing offer/index. Each appended shape references an earlier source offer. Binding independently checks exact geometric equivalence before accepting a legacy unmirrored bottom member in the new representation. Individual minority-face fanout and both-face through-hole reservations remain active.
activation: compact-stage profiler --search-strategy granular-minor+vertical+estimator-first+dual-primary; compact mode and granular-minor required
default: Disabled. Not exposed as a full-board release option, not a demonstrated compaction improvement.

tests.orientation_and_profile_inputs: 2/2 PASS, 28.45 seconds; real power_som mixed-face models, unchanged physical faces/documents/pad nets/poses, round-trip representation, prefix/index preservation, source binding, tampered-pose rejection, invalid option combinations
tests.initial_failure: The first test found existing mixed-face offers include legacy bottom members without explicit mirrored documents. Requiring complete mirror maps excluded every power_som offer. The revised implementation preserves these existing documents, and checks provenance/equivalence at binding instead of synthesizing mirrors. Final tests pass.

devkit_regression.result: Unchanged published PCB, default strategy. Not a new full pipeline qualification.

limitations: Concurrent screens are not controlled timing comparisons. Failure is not proof of geometric infeasibility. No new board release, smaller accepted board, hardware waiver or fabrication readiness claim.
